reserves.name: Other collateral
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Coinbase cbBTC, Kraken kBTC, and Ethereum

reserveReview.rationale: The dEURO collateral positions and price-mapping APIs re-read on 2026-08-11 produce the same three normalized slices as the live collateral-positions adapter: 79.9% WFPS, 19.0% WBTC, and 1.1% Other collateral. The source itemizes the residual as cbBTC, kBTC, and WETH positions below the adapter's 2% display threshold. The verified WFPS wrapper contract independently anchors the dominant token identity; the API price dimension remains issuer-provided.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current dEURO collateral positions API and official protocol documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No collateral identity is undisclosed in the reviewed source. The displayed 1.1% Other collateral row aggregates identified cbBTC, kBTC, and WETH positions below the adapter's 2% threshold, so its exact per-asset failure-domain weights remain unresolved in the displayed slice.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The live display aggregates individually identified cbBTC, kBTC, and WETH positions below the 2% threshold, so no single dependency edge is assigned to the combined slice.
